subject: Private offer: multicloud list-price harmonization & partner passback
messages:
From: Jordan Patel <procurement@acme.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Sales <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer: multicloud list-price harmonization and partner passback

Hi Vivek,

Quick one from procurement as we draft the PO: we noticed the list prices for the same named SKU differ between AWS and GCP (and Azure appears to sit in between). For our reseller accounting we need to understand how Redwood proposes to handle list-price harmonization or an equivalent partner passback so our reseller (BrightStreet Resellers) sees consistent netback.

Attached is a simple workbook with the ACME SKU mapping and the pricing tiers we expect to buy against. Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can align list prices across marketplaces, or if not, whether you provide a passback mechanism to equalize netback to our reseller.
- What evidence you need from us (invoice pathing, entity mapping, country of sale) to support passback/crediting.

Appreciate a short note and an approximate timeline — we need to send a private offer to AWS by Friday.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Patel
Sourcing Manager, Acme Corp
Attachment: acme_pricing_model.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34 KB)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Patel <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, AWS Marketplace Sales <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer: multicloud list-price harmonization and partner passback

Jordan — thanks for the note and the workbook. Quick response: we can do one of two practical things here.

Option A — Harmonize list prices across marketplaces: we can align our published list where contractually and technically feasible, but this requires SKU parity confirmation from the marketplace and can add 5–7 business days to coordination.

Option B — Maintain marketplace list prices and provide an auditable passback to the reseller so the effective netback matches your expectations. This is the faster path (2–3 business days) provided we have clear invoice routing and reseller legal entity details.

To move forward we need:
- A single canonical SKU mapping (your workbook is perfect for this).
- The reseller legal entity name and tax ID that must receive the passback.
- Example invoices (one per marketplace) showing invoice number, billing entity, and line-item SKU.

Irene, can you outline the minimal evidence set and a recommended internal owner to run the marketplace ops touchpoints? Ben — can you run a quick channel-margin calc so we can propose a % passback to Jordan?

Jordan — I’ll loop the marketplace contacts once we have the evidence list so they can confirm timing.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jordan Patel <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, AWS Marketplace Sales <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer: Multicloud list-price harmonization & evidence checklist

Jordan / team — attaching a lightweight template that captures what marketplace ops will need. Minimal evidence set (to be explicit):
1) Canonical SKU mapping (SKU on ACME side -> Redwood model SKU -> Marketplace SKU). We need a CSV with columns for marketplace SKU id and region.
2) One representative invoice per marketplace showing bill-to / sold-to entity and the line-item SKU and price.
3) Reseller legal entity and VAT/TIN for passback routing.
4) Contract or reseller agreement indicating the expected netback (if you have a target % that speeds approval).
5) If you want list-price harmonization instead of passback, confirmation that the marketplaces will accept an aligned list price (they sometimes enforce regional pricing).

Ben — see column F on the template for where to drop your channel-margin calc.

I attached the CSV template (listprice_mapping_template.csv). If ACME can fill that and upload to the Drive link Vivek provided, we’ll start the passback simulation and get a draft private-offer flow to AWS.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head, Marketplace Operations
Attachment: listprice_mapping_template.csv (template)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Jordan Patel <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, AWS Marketplace Sales <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer: channel margin calc and recommended passback

Jordan / team — quick calc attached. Two proposed approaches in the sheet (channel_margin_calc.xlsx):

1) Equalize list price: Redwood absorbs margin delta where practical and posts a common list. Pros: single price for ACME & reseller. Cons: slower and may trigger regional marketplace reviews.

2) Differentiated list price + passback: keep marketplace list but issue a passback credit to reseller to reach target netback. Pros: faster and auditable. Cons: requires evidence and processing on invoice flow.

My recommendation given your Friday deadline: pursue option 2 and set an initial passback target of 18% relative uplift to reseller netback on Azure to align with GCP. If marketplaces push back, escalate to option 1 as a fall-back.

Doc with numbers uploaded here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cSampleDriveLink
DocuSign draft for private offer routing also attached (link in related_links).

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Director, Partner Revenue Operations
Attachment: channel_margin_calc.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78 KB)
From: Jordan Patel <procurement@acme.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, AWS Marketplace Sales <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer: multicloud list-price harmonization & partner passback

Thanks Vivek / Ben / Irene — that is very helpful. We’ll fill the CSV and upload invoices by EOD today. The ACME reseller (BrightStreet) confirms the 18% target as an acceptable starting point.

Can we schedule a 30-minute call with AWS Marketplace ops and Redwood ops to finalize the passback flow and sign the private offer? We’re available Friday 10–11am PT.

Jordan
Jordan Patel
Sourcing Manager, Acme Corp
